title: A Compass for the Orchard
author: August Villalobos
blurb: Dominic Marchetti, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
